audience: shop owners who run their point of sale and stock with Hiboutik

useCases.title: Check a day's turnover and closed sales
useCases.text: The AI reads the turnover of a store for one day, or per day for a month, and lists the closed sales of that day.

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: The AI reads the available stock per product and variant in a warehouse, or for one product with its inventory alert level, and points out low ones.

useCases.title: See which products sold best in a month
useCases.text: The AI reads the quantities and revenue per product that a store sold in one month, and ranks them.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their latest sales
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by name, email, phone or code, reads the record with loyalty points and store credit, and lists their sales.

useCases.title: Find a product by name or barcode
useCases.text: The AI finds a product by the text in its name, by barcode, or by filters such as category, brand or supplier, and reads its price and details.

useCases.title: Add or edit a customer, or add a comment to a sale
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer, changes one attribute of a customer such as email or phone, or sets the comment of a sale.
